admin.exp_post: EXP for replying to a post (default 5)
admin.exp_daily: EXP for the first visit each day (default 2)
admin.timezone: Time zone for the daily check-in
admin.timezone_help: IANA time zone name, e.g. Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh or UTC. The day resets at midnight in this time zone.
admin.icons_help: Turn off to hide all icons. To hide the icon of a single level, leave its icon field empty.
admin.levels_help: Level N is row N, sorted by ascending EXP. Level 1 always starts at 0 EXP. Icons use Font Awesome classes (e.g. fas fa-star). Click Save Changes at the bottom of the page to apply. The highest level always gets the premium effect.
admin.fx_title: Shiny effect and show the level name
admin.notify_levelup: Notify users when they level up
admin.notify_levelup_help: Users can turn this off themselves in Settings > Notifications.

forum.modal_choose: Choose a level to set EXP
forum.tip_max_desc: You have reached the highest level
